introHtml: Metal attachments on lanyards provide the durability and professional finish that security and event staff require. Whether you need sewn metal split-rings for key access or swivel snap hooks for badge reels, metal hardware ensures your branded lanyards hold up to daily use. Choose from polyester or cotton options with metal accents that resist wear better than plastic alternatives. Perfect for corporate ID badges, trade show credentials, or conference access passes where a polished, long-lasting solution matters.
